listed.title: test: make linuxBind tests pass on machines with SELinux
listed.body:
Similar to https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner/src/commit/c07a9b3669dc64d498273d47ce0e6974718792f1/act/runner/action.go#L507, add the :z modifier when SELinux is enabled. I am on openSUSE and the `linuxBind` tests only pass with this modifier.
